audit_result.proof_trace: The page fetches `profile.is_admin` (lines 18-29) but never evaluates it as an access gate — there is no `if (!profile.is_admin) redirect(...)` before calling `getOverallStats(30)` on line 32. All three server actions (`getOverallStats`, `getDailyAttendanceCounts`, `getDailyAttendanceDetails`) use `createSupabaseAdminClient()` which bypasses RLS and perform no authorization check themselves. The `/dashboard/overall` link is also shown unconditionally in `DashboardNav.tsx` (no `isAdmin` guard), and `src/middleware.ts` performs no admin check on this route.
audit_result.attack_scenario: Any authenticated member (registered + card linked) navigates directly to `GET /dashboard/overall`; the server renders full cross-user attendance statistics — today's active headcount, total member count, all-member activity hours, and per-team/per-grade daily breakdowns — without verifying `is_admin`.

PROP-attendanceze-pre-004.text: Admin aggregation view must verify is_admin before returning cross-user attendance data.
